mapper.sql: FROM T_ATM A LEFT JOIN T_AGENT_STATUS S ON S.TERM_GROUP_ID = A.TERM_GROUP_ID AND S.TERM_ID = A.TERM_ID LEFT JOIN T_ATM_MODEL M ON M.MODEL_CD = A.MODEL_CD
mapper.select:
SELECT A.TERM_GROUP_ID, A.TERM_ID, A.BRANCH_CD, A.CORNER_CD, A.LOCATION_NAME, A.ATM_CO_CD, A.MODEL_CD, M.MODEL_NAME, A.ATM_IP, A.APP_VERSION, S.AGENT_VER, S.AP_DOWN_VER, S.CONNECT_FLAG, M.LAST_APP_VER
ORDER BY A.TERM_GROUP_ID, A.TERM_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql: P.PKG_ID, P.PKG_NAME, P.PKG_TYPE, P.ATM_CO_CD, P.MODEL_CD, P.DOWN_VER, P.FILE_NAME, P.FILE_SIZE, P.FILE_PATH, P.DOWNLOAD_PATH, P.EXEC_CMD, P.APPLY_DATE, P.APPLY_TIME, P.CRC_VALUE, P.CONFIRM_STATUS, P.CONFIRM_USER_ID, P.CONFIRM_DT, P.USE_YN, P.REG_USER_ID, P.REG_DT, P.UPD_DT, M.MODEL_NAME
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM T_DOWNLOAD_PACKAGE P LEFT JOIN T_ATM_MODEL M ON M.MODEL_CD = P.MODEL_CD
ORDER BY P.REG_DT DESC, P.PKG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM T_DOWNLOAD_PACKAGE P LEFT JOIN T_ATM_MODEL M ON M.MODEL_CD = P.MODEL_CD WHERE P.PKG_ID = #{pkgId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_T_DOWNLOAD_PACKAGE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_DOWNLOAD_PACKAGE ( PKG_ID, PKG_NAME, PKG_TYPE, ATM_CO_CD, MODEL_CD, DOWN_VER, FILE_NAME, FILE_SIZE, FILE_PATH, DOWNLOAD_PATH, EXEC_CMD, APPLY_DATE, APPLY_TIME, CRC_VALUE, CONFIRM_STATUS, USE_YN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{pkgId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{pkgName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{pkgType,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{atmCoCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{downVer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileSize,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{filePath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{downloadPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'D:\LGDOWN'), #{execCmd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{applyDate,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{applyTime,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{crcValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', 'Y', #{regUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_DOWNLOAD_PACKAGE SET CONFIRM_STATUS = #{status}, CONFIRM_USER_ID = #{userId}, CONFIRM_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PKG_ID = #{pkgId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_T_DOWNLOAD_JOB.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_DOWNLOAD_JOB ( JOB_ID, PKG_ID, TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, EXEC_TYPE, STATUS, CMD_ID, RESERVE_DATE, RESERVE_TIME, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{jobId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{pkgId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{termGroupId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{execType,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{cmdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reserveDate,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{reserveTime,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{regUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select:
SELECT J.JOB_ID, J.PKG_ID, J.TERM_GROUP_ID, J.TERM_ID, J.EXEC_TYPE, J.STATUS, J.CMD_ID, J.RESERVE_DATE, J.RESERVE_TIME, J.RESULT_CD, J.RESULT_MSG, J.RESULT_DT, J.REG_USER_ID, J.REG_DT, P.PKG_NAME, P.PKG_TYPE, P.DOWN_VER, P.FILE_NAME FROM T_DOWNLOAD_JOB J LEFT JOIN T_DOWNLOAD_PACKAGE P ON P.PKG_ID = J.PKG_ID
ORDER BY J.REG_DT DESC, J.JOB_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_ATM_DOWNLOAD ( DOWN_NO, APP_TYPE_CD, ATM_CO_CD, MODEL_CD, APP_FILE_NAME, APP_FILE_SIZE, APP_VER, FILE_COMPRESS, EXE_TYPE_CD, EXE_FILE_PATH, DOWNLOAD_PATH, SVR_UPLOAD_DATE, SVR_UPLOAD_TIME, APPLY_CAUSE, APPLY_MEMO, CRC_VALUE, ENTER_DATE, ENTER_TIME, ENTER_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{downNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{appTypeCd,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{atmCoCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{modelCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{appFileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{appFileSize,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{appVer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{fileCompress,jdbcType=CHAR}, '0'), NVL(#{exeTypeCd,jdbcType=CHAR}, '0'), #{exeFilePath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{downloadPath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'D:\LGDOWN'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{applyCause,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{applyMemo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{crcValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{enterUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT A.TERM_GROUP_ID, A.TERM_ID, A.BRANCH_CD, A.CORNER_CD, A.LOCATION_NAME, A.ATM_CO_CD, A.MODEL_CD, M.MODEL_NAME, A.ATM_IP, A.APP_VERSION FROM T_ATM A LEFT JOIN T_ATM_MODEL M ON M.MODEL_CD = A.MODEL_CD WHERE A.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND A.TERM_ID = #{termId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_ATM_APPLY_HISTORY ( DOWN_NO, TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CMD_ID, START_DATE, START_TIME, APPLY_FLAG, APPLY_RESULT, ASYNC_UID, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{downNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{termGroupId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{termId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cmdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), #{applyFlag,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{applyResult,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{asyncUid,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{regUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select:
SELECT H.DOWN_NO, H.TERM_GROUP_ID, H.TERM_ID, H.CMD_ID, H.START_DATE, H.START_TIME, H.END_DATE, H.END_TIME, H.APPLY_FLAG, H.APPLY_RESULT, H.ASYNC_UID, H.REG_USER_ID, H.REG_DT, D.APP_TYPE_CD, D.APP_FILE_NAME, D.APP_VER, D.ATM_CO_CD, D.MODEL_CD FROM T_ATM_APPLY_HISTORY H LEFT JOIN T_ATM_DOWNLOAD D ON D.DOWN_NO = H.DOWN_NO
ORDER BY H.REG_DT DESC, H.DOWN_NO DESC, H.TERM_GROUP_ID, H.TERM_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
